referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A straightforward small-business template. A dark top bar carries the brand and four text links. The opening is a split field: a wide image slot on the left and a short business promise, supporting paragraph, and single primary button on the right. A full-width muted callout band follows with one sentence. Three equal service cards each hold a title, short paragraph, and small action. A dark footer closes the page. Neutral system sans, white and light gray surfaces, charcoal bands, and a blue action color keep the hierarchy plain and legible.

heroGeometry.viewport: wide image slot beside a short promise and one action

typography.scale: compact heading scale with generous body measure

imageTreatment.focalPoint: subject-safe; replace the slot with client photography

rules: keep the primary action above the fold

requiredSignatureElements.description: wide image slot beside a short promise and one primary action
single full-width statement band between hero and services
three equal service cards with short copy and one action each

prohibitedPatterns: reuse Start Bootstrap demo copy or placeholder graphics as client content
copy source code into a client site
replace the split opening with an unrelated full-bleed carousel
acceptanceChecks: Opening keeps a wide image slot beside a short promise and one primary action.
The callout band remains a single full-width statement.
Three service cards stay scannable and equal in weight.
At 390 px the page stacks without horizontal overflow.

review.notes: Official Start Bootstrap demo captured at both viewports. The demo uses a neutral placeholder image slot; the dossier records the layout mechanics, not the placeholder asset.
